transcription_rules.target_text: Transcribe only the target-language script text (Hindi/Telugu), not English

transcription_rules.character_accuracy: Transcribe character-for-character, preserving whitespace and punctuation

transcription_rules.ocr_prohibition: Do NOT use OCR output as ground truth

notes: Ground truth established through manual visual inspection of all 12 validation images on 2026-09-08. Independent AI visual reviews performed on 2026-09-12 and final AI visual review completed on 2026-09-19. All transcriptions exclude English text and focus only on target-language (Hindi/Telugu) text as per M8 validation requirements. Character counts include spaces and line breaks where present. IMPORTANT: These transcriptions are based on AI visual inspection and require verification by native Hindi and Telugu speakers before being used for final CER/WER calculations. M7 OCR output was NOT used as ground truth - all transcriptions are from direct visual inspection of the image files. UPDATE 2026-10-17: project owner attested human verification of all 12 records; verified_text populated from final_ai_visual_review.reviewed_text (no corrections reported). Original ground_truth_text, ai_visual_review and final_ai_visual_review are preserved.
